display.purpose: App-shell titles and the strongest screen identity.

headline.purpose: Major financial totals and metric values.

title.purpose: Section headings and prominent panel statements.

body.purpose: Instructions, descriptions, field values, and default reading text.

label.purpose: Brand eyebrows, metric labels, table headers, and month context.

shadows.name: surface-low
shadows.purpose: Default headers, cards, fields, and content panels.

shadows.name: prism-mark
shadows.purpose: Tactile separation for the compact brand mark.

shadows.name: mobile-dock
shadows.purpose: Fixed bottom navigation above page content.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs against the dimmed viewport.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Background, border, color, and shadow transitions for interactive state changes.

motion.name: toast-progress
motion.purpose: Default progress duration for submission toasts; the duration remains overridable.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Near-instant replacement for animation and transition duration when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The dependable default for one clear, forward-moving action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--brand-600); color: #fff; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 24px; transition: background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-700); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--brand-700); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-600); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet bordered action that supports, cancels, or offers an alternative to the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink-base); padding: 10px 16px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 24px; transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-muted); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--surface-soft); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-600); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A full-width, touch-friendly field for financial and household data entry.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink-base); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink-strong); padding: 10px 16px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--ink-soft); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--brand-500); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-600) 20%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: A quiet financial summary card with a compact label and dominant tabular value.
components.css: .ds-metric-card { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--stroke) 80%, transparent); border-radius: 24px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink-base); padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric-label { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; } .ds-metric-value { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--ink-strong); font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 40px; letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation Item
components.description: The active state for month-scoped desktop navigation.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-desktop { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--brand-600); color: #fff; padding: 12px 16px; text-decoration: none; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.25), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(29, 78, 216, 0.25); transition: background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-nav-desktop svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.9; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-desktop:hover { background: var(--brand-700); } .ds-nav-desktop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-600); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mobile Navigation Item
components.description: The quiet selected state inside the fixed mobile bottom dock.
components.html: Expenses
components.css: .ds-nav-mobile { display: flex; min-height: 56px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--brand-50); color: var(--brand-700); padding: 8px; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 11px; transition: background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-nav-mobile svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.9; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-mobile:hover { background: var(--brand-100); } .ds-nav-mobile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-600); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Filter Chip
components.description: A compact, explicit selected state for sorting and filtering financial lists.
components.css: .ds-chip-active { display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--brand-100); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--brand-50); color: var(--brand-700); padding: 8px 12px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 16px; transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-active:hover { background: var(--brand-100); } .ds-chip-active:active { border-color: var(--brand-500); } .ds-chip-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-600); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Prism Title Mark
components.description: The compact brand signature used beside app identity and major entry points.
components.css: .ds-title-mark { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 48px; height: 48px; overflow: hidden; transform: rotate(12deg); border-radius: 12px; background: #e2e8f0; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.16); } .ds-title-mark-highlight { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to bottom right, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3), transparent); } .ds-title-mark-ribbon { position: absolute; left: -45%; top: 50%; width: 190%; height: 10px; transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg); background: linear-gradient(to right, #2dd4bf, #a855f7); }

narrative.overview:
Fairsplit is a calm, light-mode financial workspace where shared money feels understandable rather than clinical. The Clear Ledger pairs crisp accounting structure with softly rounded surfaces and a restrained blue trust signal, making the current month, the household total, and each partner's fair position easy to scan without recreating the pressure of a spreadsheet.

The interface is softly layered rather than decorative. Cool white and pale blue surfaces organize dense financial information; fine borders do most of the structural work; ambient shadows only separate important planes. The system should feel calm, dependable, and touch-friendly, with warmth coming from the faint canvas glow, the small prism mark, and functional category colors—not from ornament or novelty.
keyCharacteristics: Light-mode first with a cool, open canvas and clean white work surfaces.
Large, tabular financial totals supported by compact labels and restrained body copy.
Rounded, touch-friendly controls and containers with precise border hierarchy.
Trust Blue reserved for current state, primary action, focus, and important guidance.
Functional accent colors identify spending categories and financial status without dominating the page.
Responsive information density: tables and horizontal navigation on desktop; cards and a fixed bottom navigation on mobile.

rules.name: The One Trust Signal Rule
rules.body: Trust Blue is the only general-purpose accent; use it for action, focus, and current state, never as broad decoration.

rules.name: The Category Color Stays Categorical Rule
rules.body: Housing, lifestyle, essentials, mobility, finance, and other accents identify data; they do not replace Trust Blue for navigation or generic controls.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Hue Rule
rules.body: Positive, negative, warning, and danger colors must retain a readable text label or numeric sign so color never carries meaning alone.

rules.name: The Fairness Is Numeric Rule
rules.body: Monetary values, percentages, rates, and date-like controls use tabular numerals and strong alignment so partners can compare amounts without visual jitter.

rules.name: The Quiet Type Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and size within one platform sans family; do not add a second typeface, decorative italics, or oversized editorial display treatments.

rules.name: The Month Is the Frame Rule
rules.body: Keep the selected month visually adjacent to the screen title and preserve it across month-scoped navigation; the current month is the organizing frame for every financial task.

rules.name: The Soft Layer Rule
rules.body: Borders and tonal surfaces create hierarchy first; add shadow only when a plane genuinely sits above another plane.

rules.name: The Overlay Earns Depth Rule
rules.body: Strong elevation is limited to dialogs, the mobile dock, and the prism mark—never routine content cards.

rules.name: The Radius Signals Scale Rule
rules.body: Larger spatial containers receive larger radii; do not apply the 24px hero radius indiscriminately to small controls or dense table elements.

dos: Do make month-to-date totals, partner differences, and the settlement statement the strongest visual information.
Do use Paper, Ledger Mist, Cool Blue Surface, and Cool Rule borders to group dense financial information before adding shadow.
Do keep controls touch-friendly, keyboard-visible, and responsive; maintain 44px targets and mobile safe-area clearance.
Do use tabular numerals and right alignment for comparable monetary values.
Do let category and status colors carry a specific functional label, sign, or data relationship.
Do preserve the light-mode-first, calm, clear visual character across new screens.
donts: Don't turn Trust Blue or the category palette into decorative gradients, oversized color fields, or generic dashboard chrome.
Don't introduce a second font, glass-heavy surfaces, neon accents, or ornamental data visualizations.
Don't make every container a floating card; use spacing, borders, and nested tonal surfaces to keep hierarchy quiet.
Don't shrink mobile controls below 44px or force desktop tables into narrow viewports.
Don't use color alone to communicate who owes, who paid more, an error, or a destructive consequence.
Don't duplicate the prism ribbon across buttons, charts, backgrounds, or unrelated decorative elements.
